results.name: unauthenticated page redirects to login and every notification BFF route returns 401
empty state is honest: no fake alerts, no badge, "No notifications yet"
real notifications appear newest-first for the owner only, with an honest delivery line
the bell shows the real unread count (2) and announces it
filters: Unread shows 2, a category filter narrows the list
marking one as read updates the database, the card and the bell; reload keeps it
farmer B cannot read, mark or bulk-mark farmer A notifications through the BFF
cross-origin mutations and malformed requests are rejected
settings: push toggle and quiet hours are saved to PostgreSQL and survive a reload; invalid input is refused
without notification consent the settings explain why push is off
a refresh outage keeps the last list labelled out of date and never shows it as empty; Retry recovers
malformed list body is an error, not an empty inbox
a failed first load shows an error with Retry that recovers once the API is back
an unread-count outage shows no badge and says the count is unavailable
mark all as read clears the badge and only the caller rows change
mobile viewport (375px): no horizontal overflow; a keyboard user can reach Mark as read
a revoked session shows "session has ended" and never leaves the old list on screen
